new_jobs.description:
About the Company:

Our client is the leading Market Research Agency who help all stakeholders in its ecosystem.

Job role:

The Manager – Qualitative is responsible for leading and managing qualitative research projects from proposal development through final delivery. The role requires strong expertise in qualitative research methodologies, strategic thinking, project management, client servicing, moderation, analysis, and team leadership. The incumbent will lead complex research assignments, develop actionable consumer and market insights, manage key client relationships, mentor and develop team members, and contribute to business growth by ensuring high-quality research solutions and exceptional client experience.
Responsibilities and Duties

1. Project Leadership & Execution
Lead and manage qualitative research projects from proposal stage to final delivery. Develop research approaches and methodologies aligned with client objectives, business challenges, and research questions. Review and approve discussion guides, screeners, research frameworks, and other project materials. Ensure effective project planning, resource allocation, timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Oversee multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. Identify potential project risks and proactively develop solutions to ensure smooth execution. Ensure adherence to research protocols, quality standards, and organizational processes.
2. Fieldwork Management & Moderation
Lead and moderate complex qualitative research methodologies including Focus Group Discussions (FGDs), In-Depth Interviews (IDIs), ethnographic studies, online communities, observational research, and immersion studies. Develop moderation approaches and provide guidance to moderators, interviewers, and field teams. Oversee recruitment, fieldwork planning, and vendor coordination to ensure quality and timely execution. Monitor fieldwork progress and ensure research objectives and protocols are consistently followed. Review fieldwork outputs and address operational or quality-related issues. Conduct quality checks and provide direction to field teams where required.
3. Analysis, Insight Generation & Strategic Thinking
Lead the analysis and interpretation of qualitative research data, including transcripts, recordings, observations, and field notes. Identify key consumer motivations, attitudes, behaviors, needs, barriers, and cultural trends. Translate complex research findings into clear, actionable, and commercially relevant insights. Develop strategic recommendations that address client business objectives and support decision-making. Review and challenge analysis prepared by team members to ensure depth, accuracy, and relevance of insights. Ensure research outputs move beyond reporting findings to provide meaningful business implications.
4. Reporting & Client Deliverables
Lead the development of high-quality research reports, presentations, and executive summaries. Shape compelling narratives, storytelling frameworks, visualizations, and insight presentations. Review and ensure the accuracy, quality, and strategic relevance of all client deliverables. Present research findings, insights, and recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders. Handle client questions and discussions during presentations and ensure clear communication of research implications. Ensure all deliverables meet organizational quality standards and client expectations.
5. Client Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients and key stakeholders. Act as a senior point of contact for assigned clients and research engagements. Develop a strong understanding of client businesses, industries, challenges, and research requirements. Participate in client meetings, briefings, proposal discussions, and research debriefs. Provide strategic research recommendations based on client objectives and business needs. Manage client expectations throughout the research lifecycle and ensure a positive client experience. Identify opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships and support repeat business.
6. Proposal Development & Business Growth
Support the development of research proposals, approaches, methodologies, timelines, and budgets. Contribute to pitch presentations and client proposal meetings. Recommend appropriate qualitative methodologies based on business objectives and research requirements. Identify potential research opportunities within existing client relationships. Support business development initiatives and contribute to winning new projects. Develop case studies, credentials, and other materials to support business development activities.
7. Team Leadership & Development
Lead, mentor, and develop Research Executives, Senior Research Executives, and junior team members. Allocate project responsibilities based on team capabilities, workload, and project requirements. Review team performance and provide regular coaching and constructive feedback. Review project outputs prepared by team members and ensure they meet required quality standards. Identify capability gaps and support the development of team members through coaching, knowledge sharing, and on-the-job learning. Promote best practices and encourage continuous improvement within the qualitative research team. Foster effective collaboration and teamwork across Insights and other functions.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor's / Master's degree in Marketing, Business, Social Sciences, Psychology, or a related field.
Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience in qualitative research, market research, consumer insights, or a related field.
Strong hands-on experience in qualitative research methodologies, including FGDs, IDIs, ethnography, observational research, online communities, and immersion studies.
Strong project management and team leadership skills.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Strong understanding of consumer behavior, human psychology, cultural insights, and market dynamics.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong report writing, storytelling, and presentation skills.
Ability to confidently present insights and recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders.
Strong client management and relationship-building skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines effectively.
Strong commercial understanding and ability to connect research insights with business objectives.
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.

26WD98619, Search Intelligence Manager

Position Overview

We’re looking for a curious, analytical, and technically fluent Search Intelligence Manager to help Autodesk understand how customers discover, explore, and convert across traditional organic search and emerging AI-driven discovery experiences.

This role supports the broader Search Experience function by turning search, website, content, and customer behavior data into trusted dashboards, clear insights, and actionable recommendations. You’ll work with backend data systems, BI tools, Streamlit dashboards, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Snowflake, and other reporting sources to help teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and where to act next.

This is a data and insights role with a search lens. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with data systems and reporting tools, curious about customer behavior, and excited to learn and shape how search, content, and AI-driven discovery shape the journey from discovery to conversion.

Responsibilities

Build and improve dashboards for search visibility, website engagement, content performance, customer journeys, and conversion trends
Work with backend data systems, BI tools, Streamlit, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and other sources to collect, validate, analyze, and visualize performance data
Diagnose search and discovery trends across impressions, clicks, CTR, rankings, landing pages, engagement, conversion, AI referrals, and emerging LLM-driven discovery paths
Analyze behavioral patterns for users arriving through organic search and AI-driven discovery, including landing-page behavior, content paths, drop-off points, and conversion signals
Identify SEO, AEO, content, and digital experience optimization opportunities based on data, customer behavior, and business impact
Partner with analytics, data engineering, search, content, marketing, and technical teams to define KPI logic, reporting needs, and source-of-truth measurement approaches
QA datasets, dashboards, reporting outputs, and scoring frameworks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and stakeholder trust
Support prioritization by combining performance data, business value, customer intent, content metadata, and optimization opportunity
Prepare concise performance summaries, visualizations, and insight narratives that help teams make smarter decisions
Stay current on search behavior, AI-driven discovery, analytics practices, and emerging measurement approaches

Minimum Qualifications

3–5+ years of experience in digital analytics, marketing analytics, BI/reporting, analytics engineering, growth analytics, search analytics, or a related analytical role
Experience working with backend data systems, data warehouses, BI platforms, dashboards, and large datasets
Strong SQL or equivalent data-querying experience, with the ability to pull, join, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources
Experience building dashboards, reporting tools, or lightweight data applications using tools such as Streamlit, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms
Familiarity with Google Search Console and SEMrush data, including search visibility, query, landing-page, and keyword performance trends
Ability to analyze customer behavior, journey paths, funnel performance, or conversion patterns using web analytics, BI tools, or backend datasets
Strong data QA skills, including validating metric definitions, identifying discrepancies, documenting assumptions, and ensuring reporting accuracy
Ability to translate complex data into clear insights, recommendations, and business narratives
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn quickly in a fast-moving search and AI discovery landscape
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across analytics, data engineering, search, content, marketing, and technical teams

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with SEO concepts, keyword strategy, content performance, search visibility, or digital marketing metrics
Familiarity with AEO or AI-driven search concepts such as AI Overviews, LLM referrals, prompt monitoring, citation visibility, share of answer, or zero-click behavior
Experience with Python, R, dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, ETL workflows, data modeling, or analytics engineering practices
Experience combining search data, web analytics data, content metadata, CRM/conversion data, and customer behavior data to generate recommendations
Experience developing KPI frameworks, prioritization models, scoring systems, or source-of-truth reporting documentation
Experience with Adobe Analytics or similar web analytics platforms

26WD98619, Responsable de l'intelligence de recherche

Aperçu du Poste

Nous recherchons un responsable de l’intelligence de recherche (Search Intelligence Manager) doté d’un esprit curieux, d’un esprit analytique et de solides compétences techniques, afin d’aider Autodesk à comprendre comment les clients découvrent, explorent et effectuent des conversions, tant via la recherche organique traditionnelle que via les nouvelles expériences de découverte basées sur l’IA.

Ce poste soutient la fonction « Search Experience » au sens large en transformant les données relatives à la recherche, au site web, au contenu et au comportement des clients en tableaux de bord fiables, en informations claires et en recommandations exploitables. Vous travaillerez avec des systèmes de données backend, des outils de BI, des tableaux de bord Streamlit, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Snowflake et d’autres sources de reporting afin d’aider les équipes à comprendre ce qui évolue, pourquoi cela est important et quelles actions entreprendre ensuite.

Il s’agit d’un poste axé sur les données et les analyses, avec une approche centrée sur la recherche. Le candidat idéal est à l’aise avec les systèmes de données et les outils de reporting, fait preuve de curiosité vis-à-vis du comportement des clients et est enthousiaste à l’idée d’apprendre et de contribuer à façonner la manière dont la recherche, le contenu et la découverte pilotée par l’IA influencent le parcours client, de la découverte à la conversion.

Responsabilités

Créer et améliorer des tableaux de bord sur la visibilité en recherche, l’engagement sur le site web, les performances du contenu, les parcours clients et les tendances de conversion
Utiliser les systèmes de données back-end, les outils de BI, Streamlit, Google Search Console, SEMrush et d’autres sources pour collecter, valider, analyser et visualiser les données de performance
Analyser les tendances en matière de recherche et de découverte à travers les impressions, les clics, le CTR, les classements, les pages de destination, l’engagement, la conversion, les références issues de l’IA et les nouveaux parcours de découverte pilotés par les modèles de langage (LLM)
Analyser les modèles de comportement des utilisateurs arrivant via le référencement naturel et la découverte pilotée par l’IA, notamment le comportement sur les pages de destination, les parcours de contenu, les points d’abandon et les signaux de conversion
Identifier les opportunités d’optimisation en matière de référencement naturel (SEO), de référencement sur les moteurs de recherche (AEO), de contenu et d’expérience numérique en s’appuyant sur les données, le comportement des clients et l’impact commercial
Collaborer avec les équipes d’analyse, d’ingénierie des données, de référencement, de contenu, de marketing et techniques pour définir la logique des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), les besoins en matière de reporting et les approches de mesure basées sur une « source de vérité »
Assurer la qualité des ensembles de données, des tableaux de bord, des rapports et des cadres de notation afin de garantir l’exactitude, la cohérence et la confiance des parties prenantes
Soutenir la hiérarchisation des priorités en combinant les données de performance, la valeur métier, l’intention client, les métadonnées de contenu et les opportunités d’optimisation
Préparer des résumés de performance concis, des visualisations et des analyses qui aident les équipes à prendre des décisions plus éclairées
Se tenir informé des dernières évolutions en matière de comportement de recherche, de découverte pilotée par l’IA, de pratiques analytiques et d’approches de mesure émergentes

Qualifications Minimales

3 à 5 ans ou plus d’expérience en analyse numérique, analyse marketing, BI/reporting, ingénierie analytique, analyse de croissance, analyse de recherche ou dans un poste analytique connexe
Expérience de travail avec des systèmes de données backend, des entrepôts de données, des plateformes BI, des tableaux de bord et des ensembles de données volumineux
Solide expérience en SQL ou en langage équivalent pour l’interrogation de données, avec la capacité d’extraire, de joindre, de nettoyer, de valider et d’analyser des données provenant de sources multiples
Expérience dans la création de tableaux de bord, d’outils de reporting ou d’applications de données légères à l’aide d’outils tels que Streamlit, Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou des plateformes similaires
Maîtrise des données de Google Search Console et de SEMrush, notamment en matière de visibilité dans les résultats de recherche, de requêtes, de pages de destination et de tendances de performance des mots-clés
Capacité à analyser le comportement des clients, les parcours clients, les performances des entonnoirs de conversion ou les modèles de conversion à l’aide de l’analyse Web, d’outils de BI ou d’ensembles de données back-end
Solides compétences en assurance qualité des données, notamment pour valider les définitions des indicateurs, identifier les divergences, documenter les hypothèses et garantir l’exactitude des rapports
Capacité à traduire des données complexes en informations claires, en recommandations et en récits métier
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, souci du détail et volonté d’apprendre rapidement dans un environnement en constante évolution, notamment en matière de recherche et de découverte par IA
Esprit de collaboration et capacité à travailler avec les équipes d’analyse, d’ingénierie des données, de recherche, de contenu, de marketing et techniques

Qualifications Souhaitées

Connaissance des concepts de référencement naturel (SEO), de stratégie de mots-clés, de performance du contenu, de visibilité dans les résultats de recherche ou d’indicateurs de marketing numérique
Connaissance des concepts liés à l’AEO ou à la recherche basée sur l’IA, tels que les descriptions IA, les renvois LLM, la surveillance des prompts, la visibilité des citations, la part de réponse ou le comportement « zéro clic »

Expérience dans la combinaison de données de recherche, de données d’analyse web, de métadonnées de contenu, de données CRM/de conversion et de données sur le comportement client pour générer des recommandations

new_jobs.title: Sr Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

We're powering a cleaner, brighter future.

Exelon is leading the energy transformation, and we're calling all problem solvers, innovators, community builders and change makers. Work with us to deliver solutions that make our diverse cities and communities stronger, healthier and more resilient.

We're powered by purpose-driven people like you who believe in being inclusive and creative, and value safety, innovation, integrity and community service. We are a Fortune 200 company, 20,000 colleagues strong serving more than 10.7 million customers at six energy companies -- Atlantic City Electric (ACE), Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE), Commonwealth Edison (ComEd), Delmarva Power & Light (DPL), PECO Energy Company (PECO), and Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco).

We're committed to creating an environment where every person can thrive. Our employee experience is grounded in four tenets that guide how we support our people: purposeful careers, growth opportunities, community impact, and support to thrive.

In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we elevate diverse voices, fresh perspectives and bold thinking. And since we know transforming the future of energy is hard work, we provide competitive compensation, incentives, excellent benefits and the opportunity to build a rewarding career.

Are you in?

Primary Purpose

PRIMARY PURPOSE OF POSITION

Role is considered to be the Career Level. Perform detailed analysis and prepare comprehensive reports to support business operations. Conduct complex modeling, forecasting, trending, variance analysis, business case development, and other general financial and operational analysis. Monitor and coordinate activities to manage operational performance (e.g., safety, reliability, service level, productivity, etc.). Research and provide statistical financial and operational information. Track, maintain, analyze and provide current information on the operation's business scorecard or key performance indicators (KPIs). Develop, organize and present performance reports for both internal and external use. Develop and conduct short-term and long-range business planning. May develop, implement, evaluate or lead projects or initiatives (e.g., business plan or process improvement initiatives). Provide broad analytical and operational support to the business unit. Position may be required to work extended hours for coverage during storms or other energy delivery emergencies.

This position is part of the Investment Strategy team, supporting the development of the Long-Range Plan (LRP) and enterprise capital investment strategies. The role plays a key part in evaluating investment alternatives, facilitating multi-variable scenario planning, and providing insights that help leadership balance risk, reliability, customer impacts, regulatory considerations, and financial objectives

Primary Duties

PRIMARY DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

Develop and conduct short-term and long-range business planning. Conduct complex modeling, forecasting, trending, variance analysis, business case development, and other financial and operational analysis (e.g., operational effectiveness, budget, resource, workload, workforce and capacity utilization, competitor, etc.).
Provide statistical information to ensure the most effective utilization of personnel, equipment and/or materials for business operations.
Monitor and coordinate activities to manage operational performance (e.g., safety, reliability, service level, productivity, etc.) and make recommendations for improvement.
Track, maintain, analyze and provide current information on the operation's business scorecard or key performance indicators (KPIs).
Perform analysis of the operation's cost elements to ensure effective and efficient operations.
Prepare and analyze comprehensive and detailed reports.
Develop, organize and present detailed performance reports for both internal and external use.
May develop, implement, evaluate or lead projects or initiatives (e.g., business plan or process improvement initiatives).
Provide broad analytical and operational support to the business unit.

Job Scope

JOB SCOPE

This is an individual contributor position that works independently with only general direction, relying on knowledge skills and judgment acquired through education and relevant experience to plan and accomplish assigned tasks and goals. The position regularly mentors less experienced colleagues.
Position requires routine interaction with key internal and external stakeholders, executives, directors, managers and staff across the organization.
May require working extended hours and/or shift work to support business operations.

Minimum Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Business or Engineering AND 4-7 years of related business experience, or in lieu of degree, 6-9 years of relevant business experience is required.
Comprehensive understanding of applicable standards, methods, processes and practices, business fundamentals, and performance metrics in the specific functional area supported by this position (e.g., asset management, electric or gas operations, customer service, transmission and substation, distribution system operations, regulatory and external affairs, transmission operations and planning).
Advanced proficiency in standard software applications (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Project), specialized business technologies and applications (e.g., workforce management, project management, PassPort, Brio, CIS, EPS, Business Objects, SAP planning, business modeling, forecasting, voice response unit, automatic call distributors, work management, outage management) to retrieve and analyze data in support of business needs.
Ability to provide in-depth analysis and apply managerial accounting concepts, customer intelligence gathering, forecasting, staff planning, scheduling, analytical and statistical problem solving, financial, accounting, business and budget analysis.
Demonstrated strong analytical skills for project evaluation including analysis of complex projects with economic, financial, risk and decision analysis. Proficient in business case development and ability to effectively present business cases to business unit leadership.
Customer driven with good oral and written communications skills and strong analytical, problem solving and project management skills.
Comprehensive knowledge of the practices, procedures and principles of performance analysis (trending, root cause and gap analysis) benchmarking and audit compliance. Ability to analyze organizational data and complex problems, interpret and recommend alternative courses of action, and implement intervention strategies to attain performance targets.

Preferred Qualifications

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

MBA or relevant advanced degree.
Experience leveraging Copilot, AI, and advanced analytics to modernize business processes, improve decision support, and drive operational efficiency.
Advanced capability to analyze large data sets, distill complex issues into clear insights, and develop actionable recommendations for leadership.
Proven track record supporting process improvements, technology implementations, and business transformation initiatives that deliver measurable business value.

Benefits

Annual salary will vary based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and other factors: $80,000.00/Yr. – $110,000.00/Yr.
Annual Bonus for eligible positions: 15%
401(k) match and annual company contribution
Medical, dental and vision insurance
Life and disability insurance
Generous paid time off options, including vacation, sick time, floating and fixed holidays, maternity leave and bonding/primary caregiver leave or parental leave
Employee Assistance Program and resources for mental and emotional support
Wellbeing programs such as tuition reimbursement, adoption and surrogacy assistance and fitness reimbursement
Referral bonus program
And much more

Note: Exelon-sponsored compensation and benefit programs may vary or not apply based on length of service, job grade, job classification or represented status. Eligibility will be determined by the written plan or program documents.

new_jobs.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.

Description

We are seeking a highly driven Lead Service Operations Analyst to support the day-to-day execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement of Sandisk reverse logistics processes. This role will help ensure strong performance, quality, compliance, and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate combines strong customer service and reverse logistics skills with a continuous improvement mindset, problem solving, collaboration, and structured methodologies to deliver measurable business impact.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Ensure products are exchanged and returned in accordance with warranty policies, while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Analyse return, RMA, and customer service metrics to identify trends, determine root causes, and implement actions to improve customer experience and reduce return rates.
Support the onboarding and training of regional Service Centres to provide local RMA processing capabilities.
Develop and improve processes to meet customer-specific RMA requirements.
Monitor customer complaints and operational issues, driving corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
Audit internal teams and external service providers to ensure compliance with operational standards and service level agreements.
Compile and analyse inventory reports, including inventory levels, discrepancies, and performance metrics.
Forecast replacement inventory requirements to support warranty fulfilment.
Support the implementation of new systems, processes, and user training.
Create reports and dashboards to track RMA performance, inventory health, service levels, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Degree in Business, Administration, or related. Masters would be an advantage
3 to 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain and /or Reverse Logistics.
Strong knowledge of ERP and CRM systems (e.g., SAP and Salesforce).
Ability to work in a fast-paced and changeable environment while maintaining quality of work.
Electronics Industry Knowledge.
Strong Written and Verbal Communication
Advanced understanding of MS Excel, MS Outlook (Copilot would be an advantage)
Excellent reading, writing and speaking skills in English.
Requires excellent communication and organization skills.
High attention to detail with strong execution discipline
Good team player and able to work autonomously.

Lux Veritas Intelligence (LVI) is a trusted software development and technology consulting company specializing in digital transformation solutions for modern businesses.
We help organizations simplify complex business processes through intelligent technology, including Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), Website Development, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Business Automation, System Integration, Mobile Applications, and Custom Software Solutions.

The KPMG Advisory practice is at the forefront of transformation, offering excellent opportunities for individuals to advance their careers and expertise with KPMG. Looking ahead, we anticipate continued evolution and success within the practice, fostering both personal and professional development, thereby creating new pathways for growth. In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. At KPMG, our people are our number one priority. With a wealth of learning and career development opportunities, a world-class training facility, and leading market tools, we help our people continue to grow both professionally and personally. If you're looking for a firm with a strong team connection where you can be your whole self, have an impact, advance your skills, deepen your experiences, and have the flexibility and access to constantly find new areas of inspiration and expand your capabilities, then consider a career in Advisory.

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Associate to join our Federal Advisory practice.

Responsibilities:

Perform BA functions such as: conduct business needs identification, business analysis planning, stakeholder analysis and change activities, and requirements analysis and design definition
Lead business process definition, re-engineering, improvement and gap analysis of current/to-be processes with key customer sponsors and stakeholders
Maintain requirements documentation to ensure all approved business requirements, use cases, process flows, and reporting requirements are up to date
Lead the flow of requirements from the product backlog into sprint planning, providing a controlled, joined-up overall view of the business and functional requirements at a detailed level
Serve as a liaison between business owners, end users, and IT partners ensuring cohesive approach, comprehensive solutions, and excellence in delivery; Work with stakeholders, focus groups and end users to analyze, evaluate, and develop business use cases and business process models to aid translation of business requirements into functional/technical requirements
Create Wireframes / Mockups for the user stories, develop and maintain user stories leveraging ServiceNow and communicate requirements so that development teams can work effectively, and ensure areas of complexity are understood and investigated appropriately to review opportunities, blockers, problems, and issues that arise; Analyze and verify requirements against existing and planned product capabilities

Solid understanding of Agile processes and methodologies, including the ability to properly write users stories and breaking down large stories into component parts
Experience of using business analysis tools/techniques to design and deliver business change
Experience with requirements elicitation or the configuration of the ServiceNow platform
Strong engagement, communication and facilitation skills, including presentation and influencing skills

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Strategy Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The Sr. Technical Strategy Analyst serves a critical role within the Command Action Group (CAG), providing direct, high-level support to the Program Director and Deputy Director of a major DoD acquisition program. This position requires a unique blend of technical expertise and executive-level strategic thinking. This role contributes to strategic research, assessments, data analysis, roadmap development, and the preparation of materials that support executive decision ‑ making for large-scale enterprise IT initiatives. Serving as the primary backup to the Technical Strategy Lead, the ideal candidate has strong analytical capabilities, can synthesize complex IT infrastructure information into clear insights, and is comfortable working in a fast ‑ paced CAG environment.

This role is on-site at the Navy Yard in Washington, D.C.

An active Secret clearance is required.

Roles And Responsibilities

Strategy Analysis & Research

Conduct research and analysis on technology trends, capability gaps, and mission requirements related to enterprise IT environments and systems.
Evaluate emerging IT capabilities (e.g., cloud architectures, Zero Trust, DevSecOps, automation) for relevance to the acquisition program.
Develop summaries, insights, and recommendations that inform the Program Director's strategic direction.

Roadmap & Planning Support

Assist in developing multi ‑ year enterprise IT roadmaps, including sequencing, dependencies, and key acquisition milestones.
Maintain and update strategy artifacts, including concept papers, decision briefs, IT vision documents, and alignment frameworks.
Support the integration of technical strategy with engineering, cybersecurity, operations, and program management workstreams.

Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

Partner with the Technical Strategy Lead to support workshops, working sessions, and leadership forums focused on enterprise IT strategy development and alignment.
Gather inputs from stakeholders across technical, operational, and business areas of the Program.
Consolidate feedback and help refine strategy recommendations based on stakeholder insights and acquisition program needs.
Serve as the designated alternate for the Technical Strategy Lead, representing the CAG and the Program Director's interests in senior-level technical and strategic forums during their absence.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

Analyze qualitative and quantitative data related to IT service delivery, system performance, and enterprise technology adoption.
Develop charts, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate modernization trends, risks, and strategic opportunities.
Translate complex engineering and acquisition data into clear, actionable insights for executive leadership decision ‑ making.

Documentation & Executive Communication

Draft, synthesize, and refine strategy documents, white papers, decision briefs, and presentations for leadership evaluation.
Ensure technical IT materials are clear, concise, and tailored to senior audiences across classified and unclassified environments.

Job Requirements

Required Qualifications

Active Secret Clearance
7+ years of experience in strategy analysis, digital transformation, enterprise technology, or related analytical roles (Navy preferred).
Strong analytical, research, and problem ‑ solving skills.
Ability to synthesize complex technical and mission ‑ related information into concise insights.
Experience preparing executive-level briefs, reports, and visualizations.
Comfortable working collaboratively with technical, operational, and leadership stakeholders.
Ability to work in classified environments and handle sensitive information appropriately.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a highly related technical discipline. Relevant experience (4+ years in addition to required) may be substituted for degree.
3+ years of demonstrated experience within DoD IT acquisition programs.
Advanced DAWIA certifications in Program Management or Engineering.
Familiarity with modern DoD IT initiatives, including DoD Zero Trust Architecture, Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability (JWCC), and the Software Acquisition Pathway.

The anticipated salary range for this role is $175,000 to $200,000 annually. The anticipated salary range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. The final starting salary will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including the selected candidate's qualifications, skills, relevant experience, education, certifications, and work location (where applicable), as well as internal equity and market considerations.

new_jobs.title: Senior Technial Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Lvt

LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. Since pioneering our first mobile, solar-powered units, our commitment to scrappy, hands-on innovation has made us an established leader and one of the fastest-growing companies in intelligent site technology. We are building the next generation of solutions—from our physical units in the field to a powerful Agentic AI platform—that allows our customers to gain unprecedented visibility and control over safety, compliance, and operations. This is your chance to join a cutting-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it.

We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it.

A Top-Tier Growth Company: Named one of the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies 2025 and #10 on the Inc. 5000 Rocky Mountain Regional list for 2025.
Innovative Leadership: Our CEO, Ryan Porter, was named an EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025, and our CTO, Steve Lindsey, was inducted into the Silicon Slopes CTO Hall of Fame in 2024.
Product & Software Excellence: We were named one of The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023 and are a winner of the Security Today Govies Award for 2025.

Role Responsibilities

Own complex, cross-functional programs from scoping to launch with minimal supervision, serving as the single point of accountability for delivering outcomes.
Translate ambiguous business goals into structured delivery plans, sequencing dependencies, mitigating risk, and defining attainable success metrics.
Shape planning and roadmap discussions across the teams you support, making trade-offs explicit and tying every program to customer and company benefit.
Build and maintain schedules and dashboards providing leaders with real-time visibility into execution, risks and trade-offs.
Deliver programs with internal partners and external partners such as technology enablement partners, and ecosystem partners.
Protect stakeholders' time by always re-assessing tools, meetings and asks of them.
Drive process improvements beyond your own programs, introducing methods, tooling, and reporting structures that allow other teams to have visibility and move faster.
Prior experience scaling developer tools, software development pipelines, S-SDLC stages, or large-scale internal platforms.
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

Single-Point Ownership: Steps up as the single point of contact, and drives outcomes rather than just tracking artifacts like scope, timelines, and RACIs.
Customer-Backward Thinking: Understands who benefits from the work and the company's desired outcome at the start of a program, makes the trade-offs needed to deliver it.
Technical Judgment and Experience: Trusted by Cloud and Platform engineers, manages cross-org and cross-company dependency and critical path management. Effectively drive technical solutions with external partners and communicate technical plans and debate implementation approaches. Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Partner Co-Delivery: Has co-delivered with a variety of external partners, builds personal relationships with counterparts, sets management and executive cadences before escalations are needed, and holds partners accountable to the value they were hired to deliver.
Stakeholder Alignment: Acts as the connective tissue between teams, keeping everyone on the same plan as it changes and communicating clearly to audiences from engineers to executives.
Planning Tools Fluency: Hands-on with tools like Jira and Smartsheet. Has built dashboards leaders use for real-time decisions, and has strong opinions on which tools earn their keep.
Nice to Have Experience: Experience with Cloud-Edge-Hardware solutions. Technical depth to reason about API permission checks, auth surfaces and streaming protocols.

Compensation

The beginning annual salary range for this role is $152,000 - $177,450 USD and is determined by location, job-related experience, and education/training. Your total earning potential is amplified by a bonus structure tied to meeting goals, and you will become an owner from day one through our employee equity program.

Benefits

We believe you do your best work when your whole life is supported. We invest in our crew’s health, families, and financial futures with a benefits package designed to support you inside and outside the office. Full-time benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.

LVT IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.
All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. All candidates must pass a drug screening and background check upon employment. Some roles may also require passing a federal background check and fingerprinting. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, and/or to perform essential job functions, please reach out to your recruiter.

About Us

Friends of the Israel Defense Forces (FIDF) is a humanitarian nonprofit that provides life-changing support for the courageous young men and women of the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). Reporting directly to the CTO, this role will serve as a key thought partner and “right hand,” helping to shape technology priorities and deliver impactful solutions across the organization.

This hybrid position blends strategic project oversight with hands-on business analysis. You’ll work cross-functionally with teams in fundraising, finance, marketing, and operations to implement user-focused solutions that optimize our systems, workflows, and digital experience.

This is an exciting opportunity for a high-performing, service-oriented professional to help establish and scale project management practices, improving operational efficiency and cross-departmental collaboration. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, a strong customer service mindset, and a proactive, collaborative approach to problem-solving , acting as a trusted liaison between technology and business stakeholders.

Essential Job Duties

Project Management (70%)

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of technology projects (e.g., infrastructure upgrades, CRM enhancements, integrations, workflow automation, reporting, and digital tools).
Define and manage project charters, scopes, budgets, timelines, and resource allocations.
Champion standardized project management practices, tools, templates, and documentation across the organization.

Track progress, proactively manage risks, and provide clear, timely updates to leadership and stakeholders.

Analyze existing systems and workflows to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement or automation.
Translate business objectives into actionable technical specifications for developers and vendors.
Facilitate user testing, training, and post-implementation support.

Qualifications

6+ years of project management and/or business analysis experience, ideally within a nonprofit or mission-driven organization.
Strong understanding of major enterprise platforms and systems (e.g., CRM, ERP, digital engagement, reporting tools).

Empathetic, collaborative leadership style with a growth mindset.

Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.

Description -

HP's Personal Systems business spans PCs, displays, software, and services designed for commercial, consumer, and gaming customers worldwide. At the center of this portfolio is HP's commitment to delivering secure, manageable, and differentiated end-user experiences that scale across global enterprises, governments, and SMBs. As security threats continue to evolve, HP integrates protection across the entire Personal Systems ecosystem, from hardware and firmware to software, cloud services, and security solutions, enabling customers to confidently deploy and manage their fleets without compromising performance, usability, or resilience.

HP Wolf Security is a market-leading endpoint security portfolio that combines hardware-enforced security, threat containment, endpoint management, and cloud-based services to protect customers from modern cyber threats. The portfolio spans secure PCs, firmware and BIOS protection, cloud management platforms, endpoint security solutions, and innovative security services.

Job Summary

This role is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional programs within the HP Wolf Security organization.

You will drive the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic initiatives across software, cloud, firmware, and platform security solutions, ensuring programs are delivered on schedule, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Security Research, Architecture, Customer Success, Commercial teams, and executive stakeholders to coordinate program activities, manage dependencies, mitigate risks, and enable successful product delivery.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical program management expertise, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and the ability to navigate highly complex environments while driving alignment across globally distributed teams.

Job Responsibilities

Lead complex technical programs across the HP Wolf Security portfolio from planning through execution and delivery.
Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, milestones, and key deliverables.
Drive cross-functional coordination across engineering, architecture, product management, quality assurance, operations, and commercial teams.
Identify, assess, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and program trade-offs.
Establish effective governance mechanisms and provide regular program updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Facilitate alignment across global teams to ensure successful delivery of strategic security initiatives.
Monitor program health through key performance indicators, reporting frameworks, and operational metrics.
Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement of program management processes, tools, and best practices.
Partner with engineering leaders to manage execution across software, cloud, firmware, and endpoint security development initiatives.
Support release planning, readiness reviews, and go-to-market execution activities for new capabilities and services.
Coordinate technical decision-making, issue resolution, and escalation management across multiple teams.
Collaborate with product management to ensure business priorities, customer requirements, and technical execution remain aligned.
Drive post-launch reviews, lessons learned, and ongoing optimization activities.
Take ownership of separately assigned strategic initiatives supporting HP Wolf Security business objectives.

Qualifications

Significant experience in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Engineering Program Management.
Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional software and technology programs from concept through delivery.
Strong understanding of software development methodologies, Agile execution frameworks, and product delivery lifecycles.
Experience managing programs involving cloud platforms, enterprise software, security solutions, or platform technologies.
Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across diverse technical and business teams.
Excellent communication, organizational, and executive presentation skills.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to assess risks, establish priorities, and make data-driven decisions.
Experience working with globally distributed engineering and product teams.
Knowledge of cybersecurity, endpoint security, cloud services, firmware, or hardware-enabled security solutions is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
PMP, PgMP, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or related project/program management certifications are a plus.
Demonstrates a growth mindset, embraces change, adjusts proactively to evolving business needs, and exercises strong teamwork to drive collective success.

Location & working model

This role is based in HP’s Cambridge office under a hybrid working arrangement, with a minimum requirement to be onsite three days per week. As a people‑focused senior role, regular in‑person collaboration is encouraged.

HP has invested in a new, modern site, including ergonomic workspaces and well stocked kitchen facilities that included a wide selection of coffee.

About You

You’re out to reimagine and reinvent what’s possible- in your career as well as the world around you. So are we. We love taking on tough challenges, disrupting the status quo, and creating what’s next. We’re in search of talented people who are inspired by big challenges, driven to learn and grow, and dedicated to making a meaningful difference.

Why join HP Wolf Security

HP Wolf Security is central to HP’s strategy in the PC market, with security designed into hardware, firmware, and software. This integrated approach enables HP to differentiate through built‑in, enterprise‑grade protection and manageability. This role sits at the heart of that strategy, helping deliver the tools that allow customers to deploy, manage, and trust secure PCs at scale.

The primary focus of the HP Wolf Security team is developing cyber security solutions to protect our customers devices and data. The digital threat landscape is ever-changing and as the cyber security industry reacts and adapts to changes, so too do the malware authors. Our unique micro-virtualization technology ensures that customers are protected from even the most bleeding edge cyber security threats. That micro-virtualization technology forms a key pillar in a wider cyber security suite that we're actively developing. 

Our History

Inspired by the isolation principles of traditional virtualization, our team known then as Bromium, created a game-changing technology called micro-virtualization to protect end users against advanced malware. Every task the user performs, such as opening a document or clicking on a link, is isolated in its own micro-VM, with access to just the resources required for that task, and existing just for the life of the task. Protection is thus provided through isolation, without relying on detection, hence reliably defending the user from polymorphic and even zero-day malware.

Bromium was acquired by HP Inc on 19 September 2019 forming HP Wolf Security.

For more information, visit our website: https://www.hp.com/uk-en/security/endpoint-security-solutions.html

Prior experience in cybersecurity assessments, security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, security audits, or cybersecurity consulting.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, defensive security controls, and industry best practices.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, endpoint security, email security, SIEM, and EDR technologies.

new_jobs.title: Senior Security Analyst, Security Risk Management
new_jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About The Team

The Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is part of Plaid’s security organization, focused on enabling the business by proactively managing information security risks and maintaining effective controls.

Our mission is to reduce the likelihood and impact of security risks while operating a robust assurance program that builds trust with our customers, consumers, and data partners.We partner closely across the company to ensure Plaid’s platform remains secure, resilient, and aligned with industry and regulatory expectations.Security risk management is how Plaid makes informed security trade-offs—we identify and analyze the risks that could materially affect the business, make sure the right owners decide what to do about them, and turn that picture into reporting leadership and the board can act on.

About The Role

You will run security risk assessments end-to-end within Plaid’s security risk management program—intake, scenario-based analysis, treatment decisions, and monitoring across security, infrastructure, and product risk.
You will work with engineering SMEs and risk owners on risks ranging from over-privileged access and supply-chain gaps to product abuse and AI adoption, giving owners a clear, defensible basis for accepting or mitigating each one.
You will build quarterly security risk reporting and the security risk content in leadership and board materials.
You will help integrate security risk into enterprise risk management, so it is tracked and weighed alongside the rest of the business.
You will help mature the program as its scope grows, and operate as an AI power user who automates the work so it scales.

Responsibilities

Run Security Risk Assessments: Triage intake, run scenario-based risk analyses with engineering SMEs, score initial and residual risk, and drive risk owners to a documented treatment decision. Your analysis turns vague concerns into decisions leadership can stand behind.
Build Quarterly Risk Reporting: Gather updates on material risks, prepare the Security Risk Review, and build the security risk content for executive and board decks. Your reporting gives leadership a clear, current view of where security risk sits and what’s being done about it.
Integrate Security Risk into ERM: Partner with enterprise risk stakeholders to map security risks into the enterprise taxonomy, align rating scales, and keep the registers in sync. Your work puts security risk alongside business risk instead of in a silo.
Mature the Program: Help evolve the risk framework, register, key risk indicators, and risk-owner self-service as the program’s scope grows. Your work moves the program from tracking risks to measuring and reducing them.
Support FedRAMP 20x Risk Decisions: Help make sure unmet FedRAMP rules and KSI gaps carry a documented risk explanation and senior-official acceptance in the Security Decision Record, consistent with the risk register. Your work keeps Plaid’s FedRAMP risk posture defensible to agencies and assessors.
Scale Through AI and Automation: Build AI skills and automations for intake triage, first-draft risk analyses, register hygiene, and report generation—and share them across the team. Your approach lets the program cover more risk without adding headcount.

Qualifications

Must haves:

Security risk assessment:
Experience running scenario-based analyses of technical risks (cloud, IAM, software supply chain, application and product) using NIST SP 800-30, FAIR, or a comparable method.
Technical depth to engage engineers on architecture and controls, and to tell a real exposure from a hypothetical one.

Risk program maturity and ERM integration:
Experience building or maturing a security risk program—methodology, register, treatment and exception workflow, and key risk indicators.
Experience integrating security risk into an enterprise risk management program.

Risk reporting and executive communication:
Experience preparing quarterly risk reporting and building security risk content for executive and board decks.
Ability to turn technical risk into a concise executive narrative without overstating or hand-waving.

Security and compliance knowledge:
Working knowledge of NIST 800-53, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and SOC 2, and how risk management feeds each.

AI fluency and tooling:
Power user who has built AI skills, agents, or automations that materially increase risk-program throughput—and who shares what works with the team.

Nice To Have

Hands-on FedRAMP 20x experience, including Security Decision Record reporting for rules and Key Security Indicators (SDR-CSO-FRR, SDR-CSX-KSI).
